successCriteria.description: The exported function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) exists in internal/id/resource.go with the exact signature and returns (prefix, true) when value matches any of the seven Prefix* constants via HasResourceShape, and ("", false) otherwise.

Table-driven tests in internal/id/resource_test.go (id_test package) cover all seven valid prefixes (i-, img-, key-, task-, vpc-, subnet-, eni-), an unknown prefix (foo-), a too-short value, an uppercase-hex value, and the empty string — each asserting the correct (prefix, ok) tuple — and all tests pass.
All existing tests in internal/id/resource_test.go (TestResource, TestKeyPair, TestNetworkResourceIDs, TestHasResourceShape) continue to pass with no regression.
The code compiles with CGO_ENABLED=0 and passes make lint test.

constraints: ResourcePrefix must delegate shape validation entirely to the existing HasResourceShape(prefix, value string) bool function and must iterate the seven existing Prefix* constants (PrefixInstance, PrefixImage, PrefixKeyPair, PrefixTask, PrefixVPC, PrefixSubnet, PrefixNetworkInterface) — no new shape-validation logic may be introduced.
No new files, no new dependencies, and no modifications to any existing function, constant, or call site outside internal/id/resource.go and internal/id/resource_test.go.
Tests must use the id_test external package (package id_test) and the established table-driven test pattern, matching the style of TestHasResourceShape and TestResource in resource_test.go.
outOfScope: No changes to existing functions (HasResourceShape, Resource, KeyPair, VPC, Subnet, NetworkInterface) or any existing call sites.
No integration with API handlers, services, or any other module — ResourcePrefix is a pure utility with no cross-module dependencies.
No documentation updates beyond inline code comments; no changes to openapi.yaml, ARCHITECTURE.md, or other design docs.

entityInvariants.invariant: ResourcePrefix must correctly identify the prefix of any well-formed ResourceID (prefix + "-" + 17 lowercase hex characters) by delegating to HasResourceShape; it must return ("", false) for any value that does not match one of the seven declared Prefix* constants.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — pure utility function, no authentication required
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns (prefix, true) on match, ("", false) on no match — no error values, no wrapping

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The ResourcePrefix function must reuse the existing HasResourceShape function for all shape validation — the validation logic must not be reimplemented.

The ResourcePrefix function must iterate the seven existing Prefix* constants (PrefixInstance, PrefixImage, PrefixKeyPair, PrefixTask, PrefixVPC, PrefixSubnet, PrefixNetworkInterface) — no new constants or prefix values may be introduced.
Tests must follow the established table-driven pattern with subtests (t.Run) and t.Parallel(), matching the style of TestHasResourceShape and TestResource in resource_test.go.
Tests must use the id_test external package (package id_test) and import github.com/ahmedmohamedut/kumo/internal/id, matching the existing test file structure.
